1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Multaq  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - ONE of the following:  
 
 1.1 All of the following:  
 
  1.1.1 Diagnosis of ONE of the following:  
• 
Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation (AF)  


--- PDF page 1156 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1156 
• 
Persistent AF defined as AF less than 6 months duration  
 
AND 
 
  1.1.2 ONE of the following:  
• 
Patient is in sinus rhythm  
• 
Patient is planned to undergo cardioversion to sinus rhythm  
 
AND 
 
  1.1.3 Patient does not have New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class IV heart failure  
 
AND 
 
  1.1.4 Patient does not have symptomatic heart failure with recent decompensation requiring 
hospitalization  
 
OR 
 
 1.2 For continuation of current therapy
